source.python_whitespace: CPython 3.13.16 \s and str.strip() whitespace, including U+0085 NEL and U+00A0 NBSP
source.catalog_manifest_algorithm: sha256 over sorted UTF-8 lines <path NUL sha256(file) LF>, paths relative to site-packages
source.expectation_mode: static authoring-time extraction; acceptance reads only JSON; no application HTTP or Go maps used
fallback_rules: Convert Django language codes to locale names, then let CPython gettext expand aliases and merge every matching DRF catalog in expansion order.
Pinned CPython resolves base ru through ru_RU before ru, so ru permission and not_found come from ru_RU while the other four messages come from ru.
English variants without an exact catalog use English source strings and do not fall back to Italian.
For any other language or absent message, use the same message from DRF Italian 3.17.2 for per-message fallback.
Django 5.2.18 catalogs are hashed but provide no translations for these six DRF source messages.
All resulting values are stored statically; acceptance does not inspect catalogs, Python locale aliases, Go maps, or HTTP responses.
